MySqlQuery: select art.ArticuloID, cat.ArticuloCategoriaNombre as ArticuloTitulo, art.ArticuloNombre, stock.ArticuloStockActual, stock.ArticuloStockPrecio from articulo art inner join articulostock stock on stock.ArticuloID = art.ArticuloID  inner join articulocategoria cat on cat.ArticuloCategoriaID = art.ArticuloCategoriaID where sucursalid = 4 and articulostockprecio <> 0 and stock.ArticuloStockActual <> 0 order by art.articuloid
